purpose: Portrait placeholders for fictional people in an H5 interface demonstration. These photographs do not identify the fictional people, represent real accounts, or imply personal endorsement.
sourceVerification: The official photos page offers 200 profile faces, without needing generated user data.
Official documentation describes Random User as a service for application testing.
The copyright notice states that photographs were selected from the authorized section of UI Faces.

The linked legacy FAQ describes mockup use, distinguishes the authorized section, and asks that real faces be paired with fictional names. It separately calls for permission before using a face beside a fabricated testimonial.
usageNotes: Use only as clearly fictional interface demonstration avatars, not real identities or real account photographs.
Do not imply that a depicted person made a testimonial or endorses the product.
Source men/women folders are retained as source categories, not verified personal attributes.
Local files require no runtime requests to the provider. Render with object-fit: cover and a circular mask in the interface.
Load only avatars visible in the current page or list; do not preload the whole collection on the homepage.
dimensions: At most 128px on the longer edge; preserve each source crop
